maker: Eckert-Mauchly Computer Corporation, then Remington Rand
summary: The first general-purpose electronic computer made for business use in the United States, designed by the makers of ENIAC. Its first customer was the US Census Bureau. It became famous in 1952 when one predicted the result of the presidential election on television.

events.note: The US Census Bureau accepts the first UNIVAC I.

events.label: Election night
events.note: Predicts Eisenhower’s win on CBS television from early returns.
The last known UNIVAC I in use is retired.

cause: Outpaced by transistor computers; the last one in use was retired.
